items.title: The Secret Vault: GIC holds first public exhibition to mark its 45th anniversary
items.summary: Sovereign wealth fund manager GIC is hoping more young Singaporeans will join its mission by designing its first public exhibition with them in mind. The Secret Vault opens on Saturday (Oct 10) at New Bahru School Hall, as GIC marks its 45th anniversary. GIC Chairman and Senior Minister Lee Hsien Lo
